errors.text_span: the AttentionInfluence chart showing 16 categories and the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart displaying 15 categories
errors.evidence: Reference states both charts have 6 inner slices and 15 outer slices (21 total each). The machine description counts only outer slices and gets them wrong: AttentionInfluence has 15 outer sub-categories, not 16.

The reference shows these as FineWeb-Edu Classifier sub-categories, not AttentionInfluence sub-categories. AttentionInfluence has 'Teaching & resources 15%' and 'Science & technology education 10%' instead.
The machine description does not mention the inner/outer ring (dual-ring) structure of the pie charts. Reference describes 6 main inner slices and 15 outer slices for each chart.

The machine description omits the main inner categories for both charts: 'Fin & Law', 'Tech & Engineering', 'History & Society', 'Science', 'Health & Medicine', and 'Education' with their respective percentages.

errors.text_span: colored in shades of blue, green, orange, and purple
errors.evidence: Reference describes the colors as blue, brown, orange, red, light blue, and green — not purple. Purple is not mentioned in the reference.

errors.text_span: presented in hues of orange, yellow, and green
errors.evidence: Reference describes similar color coding for FineWeb-Edu Classifier (blue, brown, orange, red, light blue, green). Yellow is not mentioned; the color scheme is the same as AttentionInfluence.

errors.text_span: whose proportions range approximately from 1% to 38%
errors.evidence: While the 38% maximum for Education in FineWeb-Edu Classifier is correct, the machine does not correctly identify the main inner categories and omits the context that 38% belongs to 'Education'.

errors.text_span: Several slices are visually emphasized through an exploded or offset presentation.
errors.evidence: The reference explicitly states 'there is no visual emphasis on any slice except for proportional representation.' No exploded or offset slices are mentioned.

errors.text_span: Both charts include a legend and percentage labels directly within each slice.
errors.evidence: Reference explicitly states 'A legend is not included' and 'There is no separate legend.' The machine description incorrectly claims both charts include a legend.
Reference shows AttentionInfluence main categories go up to 25% (Education), not 23%. The largest slice is Education at 25%.
The machine description omits 'Teaching & resources 15%' from the AttentionInfluence sub-categories and incorrectly lists 'Science & technology education 19' instead (which belongs to FineWeb-Edu).

errors.text_span: "Historical review" is missing from the FineWeb-Edu Classifier segments listed
errors.evidence: Reference mentions 'Historical review (orange, 12%)' as a sub-category in FineWeb-Edu Classifier, but the machine-generated description omits it from that chart's segment list.
